description: The FinzData Quantitative Model as known on as_of: macro regime labels (financial conditions direction, financial risk direction, growth level and direction, inflation direction, macro quadrant GOLDILOCKS/REFLATION/STAGFLATION/SLOWDOWN, liquidity and credit), the growth/inflation nowcast, and the daily S&P 500 market stress probability (2-state Markov-switching). Labels are computed from each input as published on that date (no revisions from the future). Use it to answer 'what macro regime are we in', 'are financial conditions tightening', or to condition a backtest on regime.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: get_quant_model
title: Get FinzData Quantitative Model readings
